To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the brand trust of a parent brand has an influence on brand extension acceptance.

1) brand trust has a positive and significant effect on brand extension acceptance; 2) the effect of trust on acceptance is stronger for low involvement brands than for high involvement brands; and 3) the effect of brand trust is mediated by the perceived quality of the brand.
